registration_status: Committed before new rank-grid causal capture or random-null measurements
scope: Retrospective pilot on existing NRF-09/11 synthetic signed-permutation models, NOT the prospectively registered ROC-02 delayed-rule task; no ROC-02 validation claims

model_sources.hash_gate: verify SHA-256 of each exact binary against companion NRF-11 JSON receipt before any measurement

supervised_basis: left singular vectors of fold1 centered H_mid^T centered signed-permutation label Y; for k>8 fill with residual train-only PCA then QR; no calibration or evaluation data used to build basis
pca_basis: top-k SVD of fold1 centered H_mid (160 examples)
model_output: train-only linear ridge head with regularization 1 on final recurrent state h_R to predict eight original signed-permutation label channels; output Y(h_mid) = mean_y + (F_suffix(h_mid)-mean_final_state) @ W_output; freeze head before shadow tests

random_nulls.distinctness: SHA256 of 16x16 leading principal submatrix of projector UU^T, quantized float32, plus distinct 128 seeds

card.normalization: Frobenius norm of full D; also store per sqrt(k)
card.H: (C_output T)^T(C_output T), from fixed train-only linear head C_output
card.tag_source: null-calibrated ROC01 Amendment C; abstain on degenerate metrics

causal_pilot.output: finite change in frozen eight-output future readout from the original h_mid with fixed suffix
causal_pilot.linear_tangent_control: compare measured nonlinear output displacement to frozen J_output delta
causal_pilot.exclude: freeze-U as an active T-C arm

measurement: all nine registered ranks on six paired original model seeds at R16 and R32; both selected states; 128 rank-matched nulls each state; k8 frozen NRF11 comparators
decision: Exploratory only. Report per-seed means/counts, all rank-matched null empirical one-sided p and six-test Holm, task MSE and source accuracy. Do not use raw test performance for lambda or rank selection.
stop_conditions: fewer than 100 distinct null fingerprints or invalid null family
any unverified split or rank irregularity
next_prospective: ROC-02 delayed-rule task requires its own six fresh model seeds, source-distinct splits, native exact symbolic baseline, norm-matched perturbations, full 128-subspace nulls and amendment-C protocol
computational_budget: CPU only, no paid compute. Predeclare 2 of 12 shadow states for full null sweep; remaining ten are unmeasured in this pilot.
